items.summary: A Microsoft outage disrupted Outlook and Teams worldwide, with reports from scores of countries and territories. The software giant said that it was "not aware" of malicious activity that could have caused the outage.

items.title: US pushes for European presence at Ukraine-Russia talks, which Moscow refuses to confirm
items.summary: "Both sides have now agreed to expand the next round of negotiations to include our European partners," US special envoy Jared Kushner said. Moscow has not confirmed whether it has agreed to include European negotiators in subsequent talks.

items.title: NBA: Cunningham scores 52 as Pistons win double OT thriller against Wizards
items.summary: Cunningham became the first NBA player to record a 50-point, 10-assist game without committing a turnover since 1977-78.
